snippet.title: Kingdom Shell ► Console Release Trailer At Top Hat Studios Tokyo Game Show Showcase
snippet.description:
Kingdom Shell is an atmospheric 2D platformer with a captivating storyline. Explore the local lands to stop the invasion of nightmarish creatures and unravel the mysteries of the Kingdom.  Out now on PC and all consoles. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1154090/Kingdom_Shell/
